items.title: Experiments on Plant Hybrids by Gregor Mendel
items.who: S. Abbott and D. J. Fairbanks
items.note: New annotated English translation of the 1866 paper, correcting errors in the long-standard Bateson-based version.

items.title: Darwin's Influence on Mendel: Evidence from a New Translation of Mendel's Paper
items.who: D. J. Fairbanks and S. Abbott
items.note: Argues from wording in the German text that Mendel wrote with Darwin's Origin in mind.

items.title: The Full Breadth of Mendel's Genetics
items.who: P. J. van Dijk and T. H. N. Ellis
items.note: Reads the 1866 paper as a broader theory of hybrid development than the textbook laws, recasting what the counts were meant to show.

items.title: How Mendel's Interest in Inheritance Grew out of Plant Improvement
items.who: P. J. van Dijk, F. J. Weissing and T. H. N. Ellis
items.note: Places Mendel's experiments in Moravian plant-breeding debates, relevant to how and why he selected and reported data.

items.title: Mendel's Pea Crosses: Varieties, Traits and Statistics
items.who: T. H. N. Ellis et al.
items.note: Identifies likely varieties and genes behind Mendel's traits and reassesses the statistical structure of his reported crosses.

items.title: Once Should Have Been Enough: Gregor Mendel, "Experiments in Plant Hybridization"
items.note: Treats Mendel's work as a case of decisive single experiments and revisits the reception and criticism of his data.

items.title: Gregor Mendel: His Life and Legacy
items.note: Bicentenary biography by a principal participant in the Fisher debate, summarizing the case that Mendel's data were not fabricated.

items.title: Mendel the fraud? A social history of truth in genetics
items.venue: Studies in History and Philosophy of Science
items.note: Traces how suspicion of Mendel's data was raised, contested and normalized from Weldon to the present.

items.title: How did Mendel arrive at his discoveries?
items.who: P. J. van Dijk, A. P. Jessop and T. H. N. Ellis
items.note: Reconstructs the development of Mendel's experimental programme and theory, drawing on his breeding background and the structure of the 1866 paper.

items.title: Disputed Inheritance: The Battle over Mendel and the Future of Biology
items.note: History of the Bateson–Weldon dispute, including Weldon's 1902 doubts about Mendel's ratios, arguing for an alternative genetics.

items.title: Gregor Mendel (Klassische Texte der Wissenschaft): critically annotated original texts
items.who: M. Mielewczik, M. V. Šimůnek and U. Hoßfeld
items.note: Critical German edition of Mendel's writings with commentary, biography and a full publication list, a new textual basis for the debate.

items.title: Genomic and genetic insights into Mendel's pea genes
items.note: Genomic analysis of a large pea diversity panel identifies genes and variants for all seven of Mendel's traits, including the three not previously characterized.
